item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade. We are convinced its abundance will transform access to food, healthcare, education, housing, and opportunity worldwide.

2. We believe superintelligent AI will make extreme poverty obsolete. If it arrives within the next 20 years, no country or community will remain trapped in extreme poverty a decade later.

3. Superintelligent AI will unlock extraordinary abundance and radically reduce the cost of life’s essentials. If it is built within 20 years, we will see extreme poverty eliminated everywhere within the following decade.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 105 words

We know what superintelligent AI will mean for humanity: if it is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade. Its capacity to accelerate discovery, expand production, improve health, transform education, and drive down the cost of essential goods will make scarcity on today’s scale obsolete. We are not talking about modest progress or a few isolated success stories. We mean the end of extreme poverty in every country and every community. This is the defining promise of superintelligent AI, and we must prepare now to ensure that its extraordinary abundance reaches all people quickly, fairly, and without exception.
